title: Add GitHub Release artifact build and validation checks
description: Implement the build/check workflow for the chosen GitHub Release CLI artifact format. The release artifact must be buildable from CI or a documented local release command and must be validated before publication. This task should not publish npm packages and should not remove package private: true guards.
acceptance_criteria: Release artifact build command or CI job exists. Validation checks confirm the artifact runs from a clean unpacked directory. Validation checks confirm expected license/commercial notice files are included. Validation checks confirm applicable third-party content notices are included if bundled content is present. Validation checks guard against audit bundles, temp files, local secrets, vendored accidental artifacts, and unintended content. Root/internal package private guards remain unchanged. No npm publish metadata is added unless narrowly required for local packaging and explicitly justified.
notes: Per eshyra-upef: artifact = per-platform self-contained archive bundling pinned Node 24 + ABI-matched better_sqlite3.node prebuild + cli/core dist + SRD data + LICENSE/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md/NOTICE/README. Targets: darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, linux-x64, linux-arm64, win32-x64 (.tar.gz Unix / .zip Windows). Validation must run the launcher from a clean unpacked dir using ONLY the bundled Node (no system Node). Dolt is NOT bundled (stays lazy). Guard against shipping audit bundles, .tsbuildinfo, temp files, secrets, and non-prebuild .node files.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #235 (branch eshyra-0p8u-release-artifact). Added scripts/release/build-release-artifact.mjs (host-targeted packager: bundles pinned Node 24 + ABI-matched better-sqlite3 prebuild + production app tree + SRD data + LICENSE/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md/NOTICE/README; .tar.gz POSIX / .zip Windows) and scripts/release/validate-release-artifact.mjs (unpacks clean, runs on bundled Node only, asserts license/notice/readme + bundled rules attribution, fails on forbidden content; guards negative-tested). Added .github/workflows/release.yml (per-OS matrix build+validate+upload, attaches to GitHub Release on v* tag, no npm publish) and release:build/release:validate npm scripts. Verified end-to-end on linux-x64; npm run check + npm test green. Private guards unchanged, no publish metadata added. Artifact-size follow-up filed as eshyra-5cd6.
